pr_title: [Feature][Attention] Support compact KV gather for SFA DCP prefill
source_quote:
**P2 Handle packed KV in compact prefill gather**
> For sparse-C8 SFA, the cache layout has `kv_cache[0]` as a packed KV tensor and no standalone RoPE cache; `kv_cache[1]` is the indexer cache when present, or absent on packed-only layers. In prefill/mixed DCP batches this new gather treats `kv_cache[1]` as `key_rope`, which either raises on packed-only layers or all-gathers unrelated indexer data before the quantized sparse-attention path ignores it; the compact gather should gather the packed KV tensor directly for this layout.

correspondence.patch_snippet: 评后sha b9ebfe7 体现修改

rule.description: 当 compact KV all-gather 同时服务于 sparse-C8（packed KV，nope/rope/quantization 打包在 `kv_cache[0]`，`kv_cache[1]` 为 indexer）与传统 layout（`kv_cache[0]` 为 nope KV、`kv_cache[1]` 为 key_rope）时，必须按 `use_sparse_c8_sfa` 等 layout 标志分支处理 gather 输入与 `split_sizes`，不能统一假设 `kv_cache[1]` 为 key_rope，否则在 packed-only layer 上会抛错或 all-gather 无关的 indexer 数据。
checkpoints: 检查 KV gather 逻辑是否按 cache layout（packed vs nope/rope 分离）分支处理
确认 sparse-C8 / packed KV 分支只 gather `kv_cache[0]`，`split_sizes` 仅含 packed 维度
确认非 packed 分支仍校验 `len(kv_cache) >= 2` 并拼接 nope/rope
验证 gather 输入 shape / dtype 校验在两个分支下都成立
补充单元测试覆盖 packed-only layer 的 gather 输入与 `split_sizes`

antipattern.code:
def _record_dcp_kv_gather_context(self, kv_cache, attn_metadata):
        """Record the compact KV gather context for DCP prefill."""
        ...
        valid_block_ids = attn_metadata.dcp_context.kv_gather_block_ids
        block_table = attn_metadata.dcp_context.kv_gather_block_table
        assert valid_block_ids is not None and block_table is not None

        kv = torch.index_select(kv_cache[0], 0, valid_block_ids)
        if len(kv_cache) < 2:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "DCP SFA KV all-gather requires nope and rope KV caches.")
        # 错误：对 sparse-C8 layout，kv_cache[1] 是 indexer cache 而非 key_rope
        key_rope = torch.index_select(kv_cache[1], 0, valid_block_ids)
        if kv.shape[:-1] != key_rope.shape[:-1] or kv.dtype != key_rope.dtype:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "Cannot fuse DCP KV gather for KV/nope and KV/rope caches with "
                f"shapes {tuple(kv.shape)} / {tuple(key_rope.shape)} and "
                f"dtypes {kv.dtype} / {key_rope.dtype}.")
        fused_kv = torch.cat([kv, key_rope], dim=-1).contiguous()
        attn_metadata.dcp_context.gather_context = self._start_dcp_gather(
            fused_kv,
            dim=0,
            split_sizes=(kv.shape[-1], key_rope.shape[-1]),
        )

def _record_dcp_kv_gather_context(self, kv_cache, attn_metadata):
        """Record the compact KV gather context for DCP prefill."""
        ...
        valid_block_ids = attn_metadata.dcp_context.kv_gather_block_ids
        block_table = attn_metadata.dcp_context.kv_gather_block_table
        assert valid_block_ids is not None and block_table is not None

        kv = torch.index_select(kv_cache[0], 0, valid_block_ids)
        if self.use_sparse_c8_sfa:
            # Sparse C8 stores nope, rope, and quantization data in one
            # packed SFA KV cache. The remaining cache entries belong to
            # the indexer and must not participate in the DCP SFA KV
            # all-gather.
            gather_input = kv.contiguous()
            split_sizes = (kv.shape[-1],)
        else:
            if len(kv_cache) < 2:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "DCP SFA KV all-gather requires nope and rope KV caches.")
            key_rope = torch.index_select(kv_cache[1], 0, valid_block_ids)
            if kv.shape[:-1] != key_rope.shape[:-1] or \
               kv.dtype != key_rope.dtype:
                raise RuntimeError(
                    "Cannot fuse DCP KV gather for KV/nope and KV/rope "
                    f"caches with shapes {tuple(kv.shape)} / "
                    f"{tuple(key_rope.shape)} and dtypes {kv.dtype} / "
                    f"{key_rope.dtype}.")
            gather_input = torch.cat([kv, key_rope], dim=-1).contiguous()
            split_sizes = (kv.shape[-1], key_rope.shape[-1])
        attn_metadata.dcp_context.gather_context = self._start_dcp_gather(
            gather_input,
            dim=0,
            split_sizes=split_sizes,
        )
